name: Yarn of Echoes
source:
Adventurers! Pack your bags and set off on the roads of Yarn øf Echoes, a land full of surprises in a totally new fantasy world!

Weave your own destiny and that of your colourful companions.
translation:
冒险者们！收拾行囊，踏上Yarn øf Echoes的道路吧！这片土地位于一个全新的奇幻世界，处处充满惊喜。

编织你自己的命运，也编织色彩缤纷的同伴们的命运。
